human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Finish the hackathon freeze by hardening empty/no-result/partial/error/broad-query states, validating the deployed golden paths, and updating the minimum submission material so judges understand problem, solution, why OpenAIRE, limitations, and next steps. This is the final pack; after acceptance, feature work stops. Depends on: 0001.result-semantics-freeze, 0002.signal-engine-hardening, 0003.evidence-chain, 0004.golden-demo-contracts, 0005.result-ui-freeze, 0006.explore-next-cleanup.
human_pressure.why_now: A live demo failure or unsupported scientific claim can erase the value of otherwise good implementation work at submission time.
do_not_misread: This is a hackathon freeze pack: improve credibility and demo reliability without widening the product surface.
Repository-specific file paths and validation commands must be mapped from the actual OpenGap repository before execution.
A measured imbalance is a signal, not proof of a scientific research gap.

machine_core.goal: Make OpenGap submission-ready by handling critical runtime failure states, smoke-testing the deployed golden flows, and aligning the repository/submission explanation with the frozen OpenAIRE research-ecosystem-gap thesis.
red_lines: Do not add new product features after this pack begins.

invariants: Empty input does not trigger an API scan.
No results is not interpreted as a gap.
Partial entity failure is distinguishable from explicit zero matches.
Broad query results can still render but may advise narrower scanning.
Any demo snapshot is real, timestamped, and visibly labeled.
The final product thesis remains measurable structural imbalances across publications, projects, software, and datasets.

contracts: Critical runtime states: empty input, no evidence, partial entity data, API timeout/error, broad query, malformed external URL, repeated scan, and refresh.
Submission explanation must include Problem, Solution, Why OpenAIRE, How it works, Demo, Limitations, and Next.

Limitations must state that count imbalance is not scientific proof, terminology affects matching, heuristics are not yet field-normalized, and OpenGap detects ecosystem-level signals rather than paper-level novelty.
Feature freeze begins when all P0 acceptance checks and the deployed smoke test pass.
failure_semantics: Empty input is blocked locally with no API call.
No results renders insufficient OpenAIRE evidence rather than a potential gap.
Partial entity failure leaves the failed signal unavailable and prevents any finding that depends on it.
API error renders a concise retry state; snapshot fallback is allowed only under the transparent golden-demo snapshot contract.
Malformed external links are omitted or disabled.

steps.title: Harden critical runtime states
details: Implement or verify empty input, no results, partial entity failure, timeout/error, broad query, and unsafe URL handling.
Keep retry behavior bounded and consistent with the existing networking stack.

steps.title: Run deployed golden smoke tests
details: Verify AI Agent Governance, Climate Adaptation, and Quantum Computing from homepage example click through result/evidence.
Verify repeat scan, refresh, and at least one evidence link.
Verify no raw stack/API error reaches the user.

steps.title: Align submission/repository explanation
details: Update existing repository/submission documentation surfaces only; do not create a documentation platform.
Explain Problem, Solution, Why OpenAIRE, How it works, Demo, Limitations, and Next.
Use architecture narrative: Topic -> OpenAIRE scan -> normalized entity signals -> deterministic heuristic -> evidence-backed finding.

steps.title: Lock two-minute demo narrative
details: AI Agent Governance demonstrates cautious funding signal.
Quantum Computing remains a normal-control case.
Explicitly say OpenGap does not claim this proves a gap; it flags a measurable signal and shows why.

steps.title: Freeze
details: After all P0 gates pass, stop feature development.
Leave field-aware baselines, geographic/institutional graph signals, richer funding relationships, and evidence-backed facet exploration for post-hackathon work.

acceptance: Empty input, no results, partial entity failure, API error, broad query, and malformed-link states are safe and understandable.
The three deployed golden topics complete without raw errors or fabricated output.
AI and Climate results preserve the frozen semantics and caveats.
Submission material clearly explains why OpenAIRE enables cross-entity gap detection.
No new feature family remains in progress after acceptance.

must_check: All six prior packs are accepted before final freeze.
Deployed golden paths work end to end.
Missing and failed signals are never presented as zero.
No raw runtime/API error is user-visible.
Submission copy includes limitations and OpenAIRE-specific value.
Feature freeze is respected after acceptance.
reject_if: API failure is converted into a potential gap.
Cached data is presented as live.
Submission language claims scientific proof or universal absence from scan-level evidence.
A new feature family is added instead of closing the demo.
The implementation fabricates OpenAIRE counts, records, links, trends, or gap evidence.
The implementation expands the frozen MVP taxonomy beyond funding gap, reuse gap, and no strong structural gap.
The implementation weakens validation or changes validation commands merely to obtain a passing result.
The implementation modifies files outside the repository-mapped minimal scope for this pack.
The implementation introduces unrelated architecture or feature work.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Exact OpenGap test framework and concrete test files are not present in the conversation. completion_constraints: Inspect the actual OpenGap repository before filling file scope or commands.
Map only existing files that directly implement the behavior described by this pack.
New test files may be added only when the existing test layout clearly supports them and they are listed in machine_core.files.create.
Use exact runnable commands from the repository; no shell globs and no invented scripts.
After completion, perform a deterministic schema and scope recheck before coder execution.
